title_as_printed: TABLE I (densities, sound velocities of NaCl and CaCl2 solutions at 5, 15, 35 C)
pressure_note: not stated (ambient pressure presumably; paper gives no pressure for the densimeter/velocimeter measurements)

value.what: density difference d - d0; reference d0 not defined in the table (presumably pure water at same T)

extra_unmapped: -phik (x 10^4), cm3 mol-1 bar-1 (apparent molal compressibility, calculated by authors)
U-U0, cm s-1 (sound-velocity difference from pure water, measured; not a database property)
phiV, cm3 mol-1 (apparent molal volume, calculated by the authors)
conversion_needs: molality basis (mol per kg water) assumed; not explicitly stated
notes: Side-by-side blocks (NaCl left, CaCl2 right) stacked: NaCl at 5, 15, 35 C then CaCl2 at 5, 15, 35 C. The label row text is printed 'NaCl, 5 C' etc. Units of -phik: the sign is minus (printed '-phik').
quality_remarks: Reference density d0 is not stated in the paper; pure water at the same T is confirmed by recomputing phiV for NaCl 5 C m=1.0 (16.33 vs printed 16.32). No pressure is printed.
